# Qwen Code 0.26.2 identity

Secret-free evidence for `qwen.headless` on npm `@qwen-code/qwen-code`
`0.26.2`. The previous ceiling is `0.26.1` (Research 454). Tarballs were
downloaded, hashed, and inventoried. They were not executed and are not in
this repository.

`dist-inventory-0.26.1.json` matches the Research 454 digest. Selected
mapped TypeScript and the reviewed safety-boundary files are frozen under
`source/`. npm SLSA provenance v1 binds the `0.26.2` tarball SHA-512 to
the release workflow checkout. Those selected files are byte-identical at
the GitHub tag and that checkout.
